units.source_text: 久米对围棋几乎是一窍不通。

en.t: Kume knew almost nothing about go.

units.source_text: 他坐在走廊上，有时眺望山景，有时观看对弈者。

en.t: He sat on the veranda, sometimes gazing at the mountain scenery and sometimes watching the players.

units.source_text: 不过，他也感受到下棋人的起伏心潮。

en.t: Even so, he could also sense the shifting emotions of the people playing the game.

units.source_text: 名人露出一副悲痛的表情陷入沉思时，久米那张微笑的和蔼的脸，也同样浮现出哀伤的表情来。

en.t: When the Master fell into thought with an expression of anguish, the same sorrowful look appeared on Kume's kindly, smiling face as well.
